proof_basis: The production placement envelope interior is convex.
Every normalized SCPE vertex lies strictly inside the envelope.
Every SCPE boundary edge is the closed segment joining two strictly interior vertices, so every point on every edge lies strictly inside the convex envelope interior.
The SCPE interior is contained in the polygon's convex hull, which is contained in the convex placement-envelope interior because all vertices lie inside it.
Therefore the complete SCPE, boundary plus interior, lies strictly inside the production placement envelope.
